gloss: digression; side note; by the way

definitions.explanation: A remark or story that departs from the main topic. Often used as a discourse marker to introduce an aside. Composed of 余 (surplus, extra) + 談 (talk).

examples.japanese: {余談|よだん}です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: As a side note, I have an interesting story.

examples.japanese: {余談|よだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さておき、⟦{本題|ほんだい}→本題：12877_hondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}りましょう→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Setting digressions aside, let's get to the main topic.

examples.japanese: {余談|よだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百年|ひゃくねん}→百年：28401_hyakunen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧そうです。
examples.english: As an aside, I hear this building has a hundred years of history.

notes:
USAGE:
{余談|よだん} is commonly used as a discourse marker to signal that the speaker is about to say something off-topic. Common patterns include {余談|よだん}です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ (as a side note), {余談|よだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ (this is a digression, but), and {余談|よだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さておき (setting aside digressions).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {余談|よだん}です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ (as a side note — polite)
- {余談|よだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さておき (digressions aside)
- {余談|よだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ (this is off-topic, but)
- ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{余談|よだん} (a brief digression)
